description: Run an advanced web search via the Kimi / Moonshot AI Tools Search Pro API with site and time-range constraints plus structured content chunks.

apiKey.description: Moonshot API key used for Bearer authorization.
apiKey.name: apiKey

text_query.description: Search query text. Must not be empty.
text_query.name: text_query

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return, from 1 to 20. Defaults to 5.
limit.name: limit

timeout_seconds.description: Search timeout in seconds, from 1 to 60.
timeout_seconds.name: timeout_seconds

include_content.description: Whether to return full page content in each result's text field.
include_content.name: include_content

chunks.description: Whether to return structured content chunks for each result.
chunks.name: chunks

sites.description: Restrict results to specific sites. Multiple sites are OR'd; at most 5 entries.
sites.name: sites

time_window.description: Constrain the time range. start and end accept YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD formats.
time_window.name: time_window

start.description: Start date in YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD format.
start.name: start

end.description: End date in YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD format.
end.name: end

headers.description: Optional additional HTTP headers for the request.
headers.name: headers

name: kimi_search_pro
